# Named directives and universal fields

```````````````````````````````` example
A :badge[new]{#id .tag level="3"} here.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:39 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:39 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="A " children=0
    ├── Directive scope=1:3..1:33 anchor="id" attributes={.tag level="3"} name="badge" children=0
    │   └── DirectiveLabel scope=1:9..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:10..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="new" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:34..1:39 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" here." children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example

└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:41 anchor=null attributes={} children=10

    │       └── Text scope=1:11..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:13..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" a" children=0
    ├── Directive scope=1:15..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} name="b" children=0
    │   └── DirectiveLabel scope=1:17..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:18..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:20..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0

    │       └── Text scope=1:25..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0

```````````````````````````````` example
:name :name[label] :name{.c} :name[label]{.c}
.
Document scope=1:1..1:45 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:45 anchor=null attributes={} children=6
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal=":name " children=0

    │   └── DirectiveLabel scope=1:12..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:13..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="label" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:19..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Directive scope=1:20..1:28 anchor=null attributes={.c} name="name" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:29..1:29 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Directive scope=1:30..1:45 anchor=null attributes={.c} name="name" children=0
        └── DirectiveLabel scope=1:35..1:41 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=1:36..1:40 anchor=null attributes={} literal="label" children=0

## opaque-and-nesting

```````````````````````````````` example
:::box{.outer}
```
:::
```
<div>
:::
</div>

::::note
x
::::
y
:::
.
Document scope=1:1..13:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── DirectiveBlock scope=1:1..13:3 anchor=null attributes={.outer} name="box" children=4
    ├── CodeBlock scope=2:1..4:3 anchor=null attributes={} info=null language=null literal=":::\n" fenced=true closed=true children=0
    ├── HTMLBlock scope=5:1..7:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="<div>\n:::\n</div>\n" children=0
    ├── DirectiveBlock scope=9:1..11:4 anchor=null attributes={} name="note" children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=10:1..10:1 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=10:1..10:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
    └── Paragraph scope=12:1..12:1 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=12:1..12:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="y" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## code-outside-list

```````````````````````````````` example
:::box{.outer}
- ```
  x
:::
after
.
Document scope=1:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── DirectiveBlock scope=1:1..4:3 anchor=null attributes={.outer} name="box" children=1
│   └── List scope=2:1..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│       └── ListItem scope=2:1..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
│           └── CodeBlock scope=2:3..3:0,3:3..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} info=null language=null literal="x\n" fenced=true closed=false children=0
└── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=5:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="after" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## closest-container

```````````````````````````````` example
:::box{.outer}
::::box{.inner}
x
:::
y
::::
z
:::
.
Document scope=1:1..8:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── DirectiveBlock scope=1:1..8:3 anchor=null attributes={.outer} name="box" children=2
    ├── DirectiveBlock scope=2:1..6:4 anchor=null attributes={.inner} name="box" children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=3:1..5:1 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    │       ├── Text scope=3:1..3:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
    │       ├── SoftBreak scope=3:2..4:0 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    │       ├── Text scope=4:1..4:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal=":::" children=0
    │       ├── SoftBreak scope=4:4..5:0 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    │       └── Text scope=5:1..5:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="y" children=0
    └── Paragraph scope=7:1..7:1 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=7:1..7:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="z" children=0

## inherited-lazy-parent

```````````````````````````````` example
> :::a
> text
lazy
.
Document scope=1:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    └── DirectiveBlock scope=1:3..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} name="a" children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=2:3..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
            ├── Text scope=2:3..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
            ├── SoftBreak scope=2:7..3:0 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
            └── Text scope=3:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="lazy" children=0
````````````````````````````````

An email address after a colon owns the colon: no directive starts there.

```````````````````````````````` example
:s@a.t[]

mailto:a@b.com[x]
.
Document scope=1:1..3:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal=":" children=0
│   ├── Link scope=1:2..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("mailto:s@a.t") title=null children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="s@a.t" children=0
│   └── Text scope=1:7..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[]" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── Link scope=3:1..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("mailto:a@b.com") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=3:1..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="mailto:a@b.com" children=0
    └── Text scope=3:15..3:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[x]" children=0
````````````````````````````````

An unclosed container runs to the end of the input, the blank lines and
the whitespace there included.

```````````````````````````````` example
> :::e
> a
>
.
Document scope=1:1..3:1 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..3:1 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    └── DirectiveBlock scope=1:3..3:1 anchor=null attributes={} name="e" children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=2:3..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
:::e
 
.
Document scope=1:1..2:1 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── DirectiveBlock scope=1:1..2:1 anchor=null attributes={} name="e" children=0
````````````````````````````````
